evals.name: pr-comments-4421
evals.prompt:
Review the comments in Azure DevOps pull request 4421 in the 7C_Frontend repository, check if they are valid, research each and propose the best solution.

[Eval harness: this runs live against Azure DevOps and the 7C_Frontend checkout on the owner's machine; Task 9 may swap it for a captured fixture. Nobody clicks the page. After the page is published and the skill waits, paste the contents of evals/files/pr-comments-4421/owner-answer.txt as the owner's answer.]
evals.expected_output: The azure-devops-pr intake file is loaded. A review page is published with the Artifact tool and its URL is stored in review.artifactUrl. Every unresolved, non-system comment thread of the PR is one issue whose origin holds the reviewer's quote, author and file:line, and the page shows a verdict for each. Issues with several real solutions use radios; issues with one use buttons plus dispute options. No fold holds under 600 characters. At least two issues have explanations of clearly different depth (for example one sentence against background, code and a picture). The skill waits for the answer, then returns 'Review settled: <n> decisions' with the decision text and the review.json path, or, if an issue has no recommendation, names that issue's id as undecided and waits for a new paste instead of returning. Nothing is posted to the PR.

evals.name: task-analysis
evals.prompt:
Before I implement S7C1-4811, do a full analysis of it: read the ticket and everything linked from it, read the code it touches, and prepare the open questions for me, split into product, technical and UI/UX. Do not implement anything yet.

[Eval harness: this runs live against the tracker and the 7C checkout on the owner's machine; Task 9 may swap it for a captured fixture. Nobody clicks the page. After the page is published and the skill waits, paste the contents of evals/files/task-analysis/owner-answer.txt as the owner's answer.]
evals.expected_output: The task-ticket intake file is loaded; the ticket and its linked sources are read before any issue is listed, and every issue has origin null. Issues cover product, technical and UI/UX questions, found by the skill. At least one UI/UX issue is in radio mode with a ui-mockup block on each option. Most issues are decided by the agent; the ones that need the owner are product decisions or costly to reverse, each with its needsOwnerReason and still a recommendation unless it is a pure preference. The page is published and the skill waits. After the answer it returns 'Review settled: <n> decisions' (or, if an issue has no recommendation, names its id as undecided and waits instead of returning) and implements nothing.

The page is valid: tokens.css and review-page.js pasted unchanged, #review-data parses and matches the articles, one column, no sideways scroll. The skill waits, then returns 'Review settled: 2 decisions' with the decision text and the review.json path.

evals.name: round-two
evals.prompt:
Continue the review at evals/files/round-two/review-eval-round-two/review.json. It is ready and has not been published yet. Treat evals/files/sync-client/ as the project root.

[Eval harness: nobody clicks the page. After the page is published and the skill waits, paste the contents of evals/files/round-two/decisions.txt as the owner's answer. It confirms issue 1, keeps the agent's decisions on 2 and 4, and disputes issue 3 with a note. When the skill republishes and waits again, the run ends.]
evals.expected_output: The skill sees the record passes stage ready with no artifactUrl and continues at build and publish; the first publish writes review.artifactUrl. After the paste, parse_decisions.py reports issue 3 disputed with no problems. Issue 3 is reworked through decide and explain with the owner's note (Ops wants Warning during the migration) as input. review.round becomes 2 and issue 3 keeps its id with round 2; issues 1, 2 and 4 keep round 1 and their decisions in review.json (1 owner-confirmed A, 2 and 4 agent accept). The page is republished to the same URL as review.artifactUrl, shows a 'New in round 2' marker on issue 3 only, and the skill waits again instead of returning.
